connection_condition: Player attribute rows carry the player API identifier that also identifies the player master row.
description: A player attribute snapshot is a dated component of a player's evaluation history; without the player the snapshot has no meaning, and each player owns several snapshots.

connection_condition: Team attribute rows carry the team API identifier that also identifies the team master row.
description: A team attribute snapshot is a dated component of a team's tactical profile; every snapshot resolves to exactly one team and every team has several snapshots.

connection_condition: League rows carry the country identifier.
description: A country is composed of its domestic leagues; a league belongs to exactly one country and cannot exist without it.

connection_condition: Match rows carry the league identifier.
description: A league season is composed of its matches; a match belongs to one league, and all 25979 matches resolve to a league.

connection_condition: Compared against the away team goal count of the same match.
description: The match outcome is derived from the home goal count and the away goal count; the home count alone determines the home-win and draw conditions when compared with the away count.

connection_condition: Compared against the home team goal count of the same match.
description: The match outcome is derived from the away goal count together with the home goal count; an away win is the case where the away count exceeds the home count.

connection_condition: Age is the elapsed time from the birthday to a stated reference date.
description: A player's age is computed from the date of birth; later birthdays produce smaller ages, so ordering by birthday orders players by age in reverse.

connection_condition: Both identify the same player; the API identifier resolves more attribute rows than the FIFA identifier.
description: The public player API identifier and the FIFA player identifier are two synonymous identifiers for the same player, stored in separate columns of the player master table.

connection_condition: Team attribute rows carry both identifiers; the FIFA identifier is missing for some teams and is not unique.
description: The public team API identifier and the FIFA team identifier both designate the same club, but only the API identifier is complete and unique.

connection_condition: Both are stored on the same team row.
description: The full club name and the three-letter club code are alternative representations of the same team label, neither of which is unique.

connection_condition: Each match references two teams: a home team and an away team, both through the team API identifier.
description: Matches are contested by teams. The participation link is recorded through the home and away team references rather than through a membership table, so a match is associated with two distinct teams simultaneously.

connection_condition: Every league name string begins with the name of its host country, but the structural country reference is stored separately.
description: League names embed their country name as a text prefix. The country of a league is also available structurally, so the textual prefix and the country entity are related but not interchangeable.

connection_condition: The rating is one column of the dated attribute record.
description: The overall rating is an attribute carried by a dated player attribute snapshot; its value is only meaningful together with the snapshot date.

connection_condition: Both are tactical scores on the same dated team attribute record.
description: Build-up play speed and chance creation passing are two facets of the same team playing style, recorded together on each dated team snapshot.
